title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for decision critical systems
summary: UK registered small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions that support consequential judgements, recommendations or decisions. Innovate UK

title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for operational systems
summary: UK registered small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions that perform, control or coordinate operational activity. Innovate UK

title: Full ADOPT grant: round 10
summary: Farming, growing or forestry businesses based in England can apply for a share of up to £5 million for on-farm trial and demonstration projects, to improve adoption of new ideas or solutions in the agricultural sector. This is an Accelerating Development of Practices and Technologies (ADOPT) grant. Innovate UK

title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for assurance and compliance
summary: UK registered small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions that monitor, test, verify or evidence compliance with requirements, standards or controls. Innovate UK

title: Mid-range equipment for biosciences research: ALERT 2026
summary: Apply for funding to purchase mid-range equipment for research across BBSRC’s scientific remit through ALERT 2026. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for BBSRC funding. Research technical professionals are eligible as project leads or project co-leads for this funding opportunity. BBSRC

title: Eureka collaborative R&D: Globalstars Japan 2027
summary: UK registered organisations can apply for a share of £2 million for collaborative industrial research and development (R&D) projects with partners from Japan and select Eureka countries. Innovate UK

title: Expression of interest: First-of-a-Kind (FOAK) builder: programme entry
summary: UK-registered businesses can apply for support worth up to £315,000 to develop a climate tech FOAK project. Companies successful at this expression of interest stage could be invited to apply for a larger grant through FOAK builder phase two. Innovate UK

title: Battery Innovation Programme: investor partnerships
summary: UK registered small or medium sized businesses can apply for grant funding alongside private investment from selected investor partners. Innovate UK

title: ADOPT Facilitator support grant: round 12
summary: Farming, growing or forestry businesses based in England can apply for a grant of £2,500, to engage an external Project Facilitator to support the development of a Full ADOPT Grant application. Innovate UK
